node.name: playground — landing task-open-findings
node.description: The open findings on each ECS task, from the packages of its container's image host and the libraries its container's programs load, each finding counted once: one count per task (findings, not distinct vulnerabilities). A module Search because Gryphon has no multi-path aggregate (a union of MATCH clauses cannot be aggregated across, and a projection with aggregates needs one MATCH): the missing capability is a count of what several different routes reach, counted once.

input_schema.description: Which roots, and which routes from a root to what carries its findings.

root_type.description: The type of the nodes the count and the list are for.

paths.description: Edge-type chains followed outward from a task: its container's image host's packages, and the libraries its container's programs load.

node.name: playground — landing task-open-vulnerabilities
node.description: One row per open finding on each ECS task, highest CVSS first, named 'id | CVSS score | title'; the id links to the vulnerability page. A module Search because Gryphon has no multi-path aggregate (a union of MATCH clauses cannot be aggregated across, and a projection with aggregates needs one MATCH): the missing capability is a count of what several different routes reach, counted once.

input_schema.description: Which roots, and which routes from a root to what carries its findings.

root_type.description: The type of the nodes the count and the list are for.

paths.description: Edge-type chains followed outward from a task: its container's image host's packages, and the libraries its container's programs load.

node.name: playground — landing carrier-findings
node.description: One row per open finding on an Overview entity that carries one: the carrier's entity id, type and name, the finding's id and the highest CVSS score among the vulnerabilities it concerns (the component page counts the same findings). The interior of the web task reads it to place a bubble on each program and pile, and a Vulnerabilities column in each pile window.

query: RETURN c.entity_id AS entity_id, c.name AS name, c.entity_type AS type, f.entity_id AS finding, MAX(v.data.cvss_score) AS worst
